race.comment: EXORBITANT MISS (6) made it back-to-back wins when she stepped up in trip for a commanding victory over 2000m at this track on the good surface. Can raise the bar again with the similar set up. GANDOLFINI (2) outclassed in the Taree Cup two back, then resumed over the unsuitable trip with a plugging tenth over 1400m at this track. Comes to hand quickly and finds a suitable race from the good barrier. FARRAIGE (8) dropped in trip on the quick backup with a slashing victory over 1512m at Port Macquarie in BM50 class with the 61kg. Meeting a deeper field this time and don't dismiss at the weights. JUST SHANE (3) struggled in town at his last two starts and assess on the sound second at Kembla Grange over this trip four back. Improver who can return to form.
